title: Earth to the edge of the observable universe
description: A measured scale journey from Earth to the cataloged extragalactic field.

steps.title: Earth as the starting scale
steps.body: Earth provides the observing baseline. The atlas position is heliocentric and projected onto the ecliptic plane.

steps.title: The planetary neighborhood
steps.body: At Solar System scale, planetary distances remain physical. The ruler does not compress empty space.

steps.title: Nearby stellar space
steps.body: The Sun becomes one star among measured neighbors. Gaia astrometry supplies positions for the quality-selected stellar layer.

steps.title: Across the Milky Way
steps.body: The map shows a top-down physical projection. Source z coordinates are retained even though this view displays x and y.

steps.title: The cataloged observable field
steps.body: DESI DR1 galaxies and quasars trace its spectroscopic footprint. Quaia adds a broad quasar-candidate layer with inferred redshifts. Blank regions can reflect selection and footprint, not empty space.
